debug.readyEditOnly: Editing only (finish the current prompt to move or fight)
debug.busy: Game busy: wait for the command prompt
debug.godModeHint: While god mode is on, the party takes no damage (fights, traps, poison, hunger).
debug.karmaHint: 0 = virtue elevated (partial Avatar); 99 = ready to be elevated at the shrine.
debug.inDungeon: In a dungeon (teleport from the overworld or a town)
debug.moonsHint: The open moongate is the one of Trammel's phase; it leads to the gate of Felucca's phase (both 4: Shrine of Spirituality).
debug.gatesHint: A gate opens when Trammel is in its phase and is the destination when Felucca is in its phase. Open sets Trammel to the gate's phase.
debug.fightHint: Starts a fight on the overworld or in a town, as if the creature attacked.
debug.mixturesHint: Each cast uses one mixture and the spell's MP.
debug.castAny: Cast any spell (99 mixtures, full MP)
debug.testsHint: Each button sets up the state (items, mixtures, position) to try the feature; the panel then closes.
debug.test.blink.hint: Near Lord British's castle with Blink mixtures: C, B, then a direction.
debug.test.gate.hint: Near Lord British's castle with Gate mixtures: C, G, then a phase 1-8.
debug.test.winds.hint: On a ship near Britain with Winds mixtures: C, W, then the direction the wind comes from.
debug.test.dispell.hint: An energy field east of the party: C, D, then East.
debug.test.energy.hint: Starts a fight with Energy mixtures: C, E, a field type, then a direction.
debug.test.open.hint: A chest under the party with Open mixtures: C, O.
debug.test.cannons.hint: On a ship facing west, a pirate ship two squares north: F, then North.
debug.test.newOrder.hint: Fills the party to 8 members: N, then two member numbers.
debug.test.telescope.hint: On the telescope of the Lycaeum: S, then a town letter A-P.
debug.test.altars.hint: All stones, at Deceit with X/Y/Z mixtures: reach an altar room, then U, stone, and the stone colours.
debug.test.abyss.hint: Bell, book, candle used, all stones, 8 elevated members: enters the Abyss. On each altar: U, stone, the virtue, then its stone.
debug.test.codex.hint: Same state as the Abyss, then the Chamber of the Codex directly (word of passage, then the questions).
